narrative.overview: The page is a terminal session the visitor runs against the vault. Every surface is a CRT screen on true black, and every claim is shown as output, never asserted as a slogan: real ciphertext, verbatim Postgres error codes, real KDF parameters. Display type glows; everything else is quiet, monospaced and exact.
keyCharacteristics: True black ground with green phosphor as the single working colour.
VT323 for display only; JetBrains Mono for every line a person reads.
Box-drawing glyphs for every frame and rule; only buttons and chips keep 1px strokes.
No cards, no radius, no box shadows.
Red and amber only carry meaning: refusal and honest warning.

rules.name: The One Phosphor Rule
rules.body: Green is the only colour that decorates. Red and amber appear only where the content is a refusal or a warning.

rules.name: The Bitmap Is For Voice Rule
rules.body: VT323 never sets anything under 2.6rem. Anything smaller is JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The No Box Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. Phosphor glows; it does not float.

rules.name: The Drawn Frame Rule
rules.body: Containers are drawn with box-drawing glyphs, never CSS borders. Only interactive controls carry a 1px stroke.

dos: **Do** show proof as terminal output generated by the product's own code (`encryptJson`, real error codes).
**Do** keep Void Black (#000000) as the page ground.
**Do** theme the browser surfaces: selection is green with black text, the caret is green, the scrollbar is Phosphor Line.
**Do** keep one orchestrated motion moment (the hero auto-run) and nothing else animated except cursors.
donts: **Don't** use box shadows, rounded corners, cards or CSS borders on containers.
**Don't** use red or amber as decoration.
**Don't** invent metrics, users, audits or crack-speed benchmarks; PRODUCT.md lists what is real.
